description: Mark an open quote accepted (the customer agreed; it can then become a sales order with convert_quote) or canceled (withdrawn or declined). A converted or canceled quote cannot change. Two-step: preview=true, then commit with the previewReceipt.

clientId.description: Must be omitted: quotes belong to the house, not to a 3PL client.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-generated idempotency key; required with previewReceipt to commit.

preview.description: Step 1 of the required two-step write: set true to validate and receive a structured preview plus a single-use previewReceipt. Nothing is written until the commit call.

previewReceipt.description: Step 2: the receipt returned by the preview call. Supply with a fresh idempotencyKey to commit.

quoteId.description: Quote id (GUID) or number from list_invoices with documentKind=quote.

name: update_quote_status
title: Update Quote Status
